tagline: A cushioned edge on all four sides, so wherever they turn there is something to lean on.
lead: A dog who likes to feel something on every side gets a cushioned edge wherever they turn in the night.
value: Memory foam that doesn't pack down, and a waterproof liner so one accident doesn't end it: the two parts that usually fail on a cheap bed.
intro: Willow is a memory foam dog bed with a bolster on all four sides, a raised rim for a chin and a waterproof inner liner under a zipped cover. Large, 90 × 65cm.
points: Cushioned all the way round the sleeping area, with a rim to rest a chin on.
Foam that keeps its shape, rather than filling that packs down.
Sits between the cover and the foam.
Unzips to wash, following the sewn-in care label.
best_for: Dogs who curl up tight, sleep pressed into corners, or settle better with something on every side.
fit_note: The four-sided border takes up a good part of the outside footprint, so measure your dog curled up rather than stretched out. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Unzip the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.
seo_title: Four-Sided Memory Foam Bolster Dog Bed, Large | Snoozly
seo_description: Memory foam bolster dog bed with a cushioned edge on all four sides, for dogs who curl up tight. Waterproof liner, zipped washable cover. Large, 90 × 65cm.
